jei.ryzergen.info.microreactor: Part of the microreactor: one Reactor Heart, two Reactor Machine Units and one Coolant Jacket, in a block 1 wide, 2 deep and 2 high (the heart can go anywhere in it). Hold a part to see an outline of where the rest go; placing the last snaps it into one machine. Break any part to take it apart.
jei.ryzergen.info.fission_station: Part of the fission power station, a round tower 12 blocks across and 11 high. Place the Station Control Core first: it shows an outline of every part, and if you give it the parts (by hand or pipe) it builds the station itself. Its ports are on the sides of the base: water and fuel go in on your left as you face the front, and energy and spent rods come out on your right.
jei.ryzergen.info.station_core: Goes in the fission station's core grid. Graphite blocks are moderators: fuel beside one makes 40% more heat at no extra burn. Control rods take 35% off the heat and burn of the fuel beside them, to tame a layout that runs too hot.
jei.ryzergen.info.fittings: Fits one side of a cable or pipe, in its panel (right-click the cable with an empty hand). It raises the limit for what comes in on that side: pulled by an extract side, pushed in by a generator, or drawn from a battery. Silver 8x, Busbar 32x, Cryogenic 1024x. Each tier is crafted from the one before.
item.ryzergen.flow_scanner.tooltip: Hold it to see what comes into every pipe and cable nearby. Green is idle, red is at the input's limit.
item.ryzergen.geiger_counter.tooltip: Shows your dose and the radiation around you, and clicks near sources. Carry it, or clip it to your belt. Shift-right-click to mute.
